description.value: Blacktail is a dual-concept establishment in Daajing Giids on Haida Gwaii, pairing a daytime bakery-cafe with an evening upscale restaurant. The dining room is modern and social, and the business has an expansive patio overlooking the downtown core and the harbour below. Founded in 2019, it draws on locally sourced fish and seafood alongside an ambitious cocktail and wine program, making it a notable dining destination in this remote coastal community.

address.value: 3207 Wharf Way, Daajing Giids, Haida Gwaii

OSM tags confirm diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:vegan=no, which are corroborated by the website menu showing multiple vegetarian large plates (mushroom pasta, arrabbiata pasta) and the absence of explicit vegan-labelled dishes.
